premises.text: Scalable reliable backends require distributed databases rather than a single-node database
premises.evidence_span: the future of databases is distributed. It's really the only way how you can build a scalable, reliable back end

premises.text: Building a distributed backend today means combining many stores and struggling with sync, sharding, scaling, and replication
premises.evidence_span: You have to combine a lot of different technologies

premises.text: Crate provides real-time SQL in a distributed environment that is simple to install, run, and program

premises.text: The cluster self-heals missing nodes while clients keep accessing data

premises.text: Crate can run in cloud, on-premise, or on consumer-grade hardware clusters
